scope: repository-state international coverage audit with exact-head candidate evidence overlay
single_truth_policy: The CLI JSON/Markdown output is generated; no checked-in manually maintained coverage matrix is kept.
Canonical registry state and unmerged current-main candidate state remain distinguishable.
A workflow file or evidence document is provenance only and cannot establish LIVE_VALIDATED.
Candidate TESTED requires SUCCESS quality evidence whose proof head exactly equals the candidate head and whose base_main_sha equals the evidence manifest canonical_main_sha.
Candidate LIVE_VALIDATED requires SUCCESS live evidence whose proof head exactly equals the candidate head and whose base_main_sha equals the evidence manifest canonical_main_sha.
EMPTY_VALID_RESULT is a valid live result kind and never means source failure or a matching opportunity existed.
SUPERSEDED is explicit evidence, never inferred merely from PR age.

validation.historical_runs: evidence only; not accepted as current exact-head proof after reconciliation
validation.current_exact_head: must be recorded in PR body after the final self-validating workflow run

rollback: Revert PR #192 or remove only the auditor files listed in files_added. No canonical source/runtime/queue state requires rollback.
